Meanwhile, the rules are swinging back.

2024–25

The six largest US banks leave the Net-Zero Banking Alliance.

Aug 2025

The alliance suspends its activities.

Mar 2026

EU Omnibus in force: sustainability reporting narrowed to the largest firms; climate transition plans dropped from due diligence.

Sources: Directive (EU) 2026/470; press coverage of NZBA exits (2024–25).
